profile.summary: Bay Alarm is a security company that provides burglar alarms, fire alarms, video security, access control, and 24/7 monitoring for businesses and homes. It also offers on-site security agents. The company was founded in Oakland in 1946 and serves customers in California, Arizona, and Washington.

review.notes: Bay Alarm Company (bayalarm.com) has a Concord, CA branch at 5130 Commercial Circle and offers alarm monitoring and on-site security agent/response services, matching OUSD's monitoring and response-and-patrol agreements. The summary (services, 1946 Oakland founding, CA/AZ/WA), website and sales phone 1-800-610-1000 are supported by the cited pages.
